requirements.name: The written mathematics does not prove the architecture asserted from it
requirements.classification: Wrong model correspondence and unsupported inference; preserve correct arithmetic at its scope
requirements.historical_requirement_or_mechanism: The language science section uses Catalan counts of binary parenthesizations (four leaves→five shapes; six→42) to claim the reading stages at most five/42 shapes. The inspected stager instead enumerates n(n+1)^n parent assignments with a chosen doing:2500 candidates at four groups and705894 at six, before exclusions. Its 5000-word three-token arithmetic is numerically correct, but the assumed grammatical fraction and exposure estimate do not prove all storage mechanisms impossible. A rule accepting its own output need not produce endlessly new outputs; an identity rule is a counterexample. A speech-rate number alone supplies no lower bound proving fresh construction impossible.
requirements.current_disposition: This is an exact source/design correspondence and logical audit, not a product benchmark, a proof against composition or a diagnosis of Task1434. The Catalan sequence can be valid for its own structures while being the wrong bound for this implementation. The current native substrate has a separate physical/resource contract.
requirements.lawful_remedy: Specify the actual state space, recurrence, candidate domain, physical units and computational bound. Keep empirical speech/memory observations conditional on original evidence. Do not turn correct arithmetic over assumed inputs into a necessity theorem, or enlarge budgets to conceal the missing mapping.

requirements.name: Benchmark retractions invalidate broad passes but do not prohibit independent human judgment
requirements.classification: Historical false-positive evidence and overstated replacement test
requirements.historical_requirement_or_mechanism: The white language record reports63/70 builder-chosen sentences against3/20 sampled from the actual writing,29/30 order cases while two statements in five were misread, a failing case pruned from a perfect bench, and a declared-subject proxy scoring73% against74% random words. It explicitly leaves fluent prose at a three-bare-word ceiling. The color then labels arithmetic a bench that cannot be gamed and dismisses hand-labelled tests categorically.
requirements.current_disposition: These are recorded retractions; original complete traces and their exact test/serving paths remain unauthenticated here. A weak subject proxy does not establish failure on every possible task, and an arithmetic pass does not prove speech. Independent blinded listeners or validated labels can measure narrowly specified intelligibility/meaning; the flaw is biased or circular evidence, not the mere presence of human judgment.
requirements.lawful_remedy: Preserve every failed case and authenticate original denominators, selection rules and execution paths. Use complementary tests tied to the actual claim: physical causal controls, independent grounded task outcomes, and blinded perceptual evidence where appropriate. No single benchmark is immune to gaming by its subject matter.
